home.lead: Rituals, songs, crafts and spoken histories leave with the people who remember them. Here we record them — one small recording at a time.
home.searchLabel: Find a recording in the archive
home.startHere: Where to start: pick one task from the list and sign up for it. One task means a few days, not half a year.
about.archive.title: We keep it
about.archive.text: We record songs, rituals and crafts from those who still remember them. The person's name stays beside the recording for good.
about.people.title: We find each other
about.people.text: Here you can see who remembers what and who can help: record, translate, drive, arrange.
about.tasks.title: One at a time
about.tasks.text: Not «save the culture», but one task for a few days: visit one person and record one song.
manifesto.title: Why the hurry
manifesto.p1: Every year someone takes with them what no one else knows. A lullaby only their mother sang. The order of a rite as one village kept it. The name of a pattern that appears in no book.
manifesto.p2: It does not vanish loudly. It simply stops being heard: there is no one left to ask, and no one left to answer.
manifesto.p3: The young are not turning away from tradition — more often there is simply no one to take it from. Between the person who remembers and the person who could learn there is nothing but time. And time is against us.
manifesto.p4: So this is not a museum. Here there is a recording you can listen to, the name of the person it came from, and a task you can finish over a weekend.
manifesto.closing: One song, one story, one craft at a time — that is how the thread holds.
